vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: router
Version: 1.0.0

This skill bundle is benign. It provides instructions and data for an AI agent to cost-optimize its operations by routing tasks to different models based on complexity and cost. The `SKILL.md` file contains detailed guidance on model tiers, task classification, and behavioral rules, all focused on efficient resource utilization. The `references/openrouter-models.json` and `references/openrouter-models.md` files serve as data and documentation for available models and their pricing. There is no evidence of intentional harmful behavior such as data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence, or prompt injection with a harmful objective. The examples of agent commands, like `sessions_spawn` in `SKILL.md`, demonstrate legitimate agent capabilities rather than malicious intent.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only model-routing policy: its requirements and instructions match its stated purpose and it does not request extra credentials or install code.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (model routing / cost optimization) align with the provided artifacts: SKILL.md contains a clear routing policy, tiered model lists, and JSON/MD reference data about models. The skill does not request unrelated credentials, binaries, or config access.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to classifying tasks and selecting model tiers; they do not instruct the agent to read arbitrary system files, access environment variables, or exfiltrate data. The included references are static model metadata used for routing decisions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only — so nothing is written to disk or downloaded during install. This is the lowest-risk installation footprint and is proportionate for the skill's purpose.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. That matches expectations: the skill recommends which model to use but does not itself require provider keys or tokens.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and disable-model-invocation is false (normal). The skill does not request permanent presence or system-wide changes and does not modify other skills' configurations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a routing policy only — it tells an agent which model tier to use. Before enabling: (1) understand that following its recommendations will cause your agent to send prompts/data to whichever model providers your agent is configured to use (the skill itself has no credentials), so verify the providers' privacy/logging policies; (2) review the included model list for any models marked as logging data (e.g., the 'Aurora Alpha' entry notes prompts/completions may be logged); (3) ensure sensitive data is not routed to cheaper or free providers unless acceptable; and (4) test the routing in a safe environment to confirm behavior matches expectations.
